quote: UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] §5 and [CR3] LINK 4; Mary's phrase "thy father" is immediately qualified by the child's reference to "my Father's business."
why: Rule K-C applies only when the pressed witnesses are the pressing side's own chain read together, and the judge text weighs a single verse pair (Luke 2:48 against 2:49) without identifying any chain, so the rule's condition is not shown to hold and the text does not invoke the stating-verse test.
